welcome-sub: Ẹnubode lati Mu Africa Lagbara Nipasẹ Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Ni ayẹyẹ Ọjọ Africa 25th, ohun elo Ikẹkọ Pi Pioneers yii ti ṣe ifilọlẹ)
intro-p1: Pi Network jẹ owo oni-nọmba ati iṣẹ akanṣe ilolupo agbaye ti a ṣe lati jẹ ki cryptocurrency wa ati wulo fun gbogbo eniyan.
intro-p2: Ko dabi awọn cryptocurrency ibile ti o nilo awọn ẹrọ iwakusa gbowolori, Pi Network ngbanilaaye awọn eniyan lasan lati kopa ta taara lati awọn foonu wọn.
intro-list:
• Kọ eto-ọrọ oni-nọmba ti o pẹlu gbogbo eniyan
  • Mu awọn eniyan lasan lagbara ni agbaye
  • Mu lilo gidi pọ si
  • Ṣe atilẹyin iṣowo eniyan-si-eniyan
ch1-p1: Igbesẹ 1: Ṣe igbasilẹ Pi Network - Lo ọna asopọ: minepi.com/chigalex1
ch1-p2: Igbesẹ 2: Forukọsilẹ pẹlu Facebook tabi Foonu → Tẹ koodu: CHIGALEX1 → Gba ere 1 Pi
ch1-p3: Iwakusa Ojoojumọ: Pada ni gbogbo wakati 24 ki o tẹ bọtini manamana lati tẹsiwaju iwakusa.
ch1-list:
• Ṣẹda apamọwọ Pi ni aabo
  • Pari 2FA
  • Pari KYC
  • Mura fun ijira Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Aabo Apamọwọ: Maṣe pin awọn ọrọ 24 passphrase rẹ lailai! Ẹgbẹ Pi Core KII YOO beere lọwọ rẹ!
ch2-p1: Apamọwọ Pi rẹ ni banki rẹ ninu Pi Ecosystem. O di awọn owó Pi rẹ mu ni aabo lori blockchain.
ch2-p2: Bi o ṣe le ṣẹda: Ṣii Pi Browser → Wallet → Ṣẹda Wallet → DA awọn ọrọ rẹ 24 kọ → Fipamọ ni offline ni awọn aaye 2 ailewu.
ch2-p3: Gbigba Pi: Pin adirẹsi gbangba rẹ (bẹrẹ pẹlu G...). Fifiranṣẹ Pi: Lẹẹ adirẹsi olugba, tẹ iye, jẹrisi.
ch2a: ORI 2A — IKẸKỌ APAMỌWỌ TI O WULO
ch2a-p1: Iṣe: Bẹrẹ pẹlu iye idanwo kekere (1 Pi). Jẹrisi awọn lẹta 4 akọkọ ati 4 ikẹhin ti adirẹsi baamu. Maṣe lẹẹ passphrase rẹ lori oju opo wẹẹbu eyikeyi!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser dabi Google Play Store fun Pi. DApps jẹ awọn ohun elo ti a pin kaakiri fun lilo gidi — riraja, ẹkọ, awọn ere, awọn iṣẹ gbogbo ni lilo Pi.
ch4-p1: Ṣe awari awọn iṣowo ti o gba Pi ni agbaye lori mapofpi.com. Forukọsilẹ iṣowo tirẹ ki o bẹrẹ gbigba Pi fun awọn ọja ati iṣẹ.
ch5-p1: Iye Ijẹrisi Agbaye (GCV) n gba lilo gidi niyanju. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Iye yii jẹ nipasẹ awọn pioneers ti nlo Pi ni iṣowo gidi.
ch6-p1: Kẹkọọ iwe afọwọkọ Doris Yin fun ẹda ohun elo ati idagbasoke ilolupo. Ṣe iwadi, kọ ẹkọ, ki o kọ awọn miiran — eyi ni bi a ṣe n mu Africa lagbara.
